evidence.description: insertPayjpEvent SQL INSERT omits ignore_reason, fail_reason, data_metadata_operation_id columns despite PayjpEventInsert type declaring them and callers populating them. REQ-SYNC-002 and REQ-SYNC-014 violated.
REQ-SYNC-024 escalation log missing resolution_possible, assignee, detected_at fields.
REQ-SYNC-021 member not found should exit 1 (CLI error), implementation produces exit 2.
REQ-SYNC-022 missing post-completion inflight residual verification.
REQ-SYNC-023 failed_count not reconciled with countUnresolvedImpactLogs.
INT-SYNC-028 is tautological: does not verify operation_id is persisted to DB, which it is not (FIND-002).
INT-SYNC-036 concurrent webhook test does not verify advisory locking — mock DB has no lock semantics.
INT-SYNC-025 mocks away retry logic entirely — does not test 429/5xx retry behavior.
INT-SYNC-027 log security test passes because raw body is never logged, not because masking works.
No pg_advisory_xact_lock for concurrent member updates. REQ-SYNC-029 violated.
validateWebhookToken short-circuits on length mismatch, leaking timing information. Not constant-time per REQ-SYNC-001.
Date.now()-based fallback event IDs are non-deterministic and collision-prone.
SQL column names interpolated from object keys without whitelist validation.
Pure core imports node:crypto (timingSafeEqual). While deterministic, this introduces a native module dependency into the pure core. Spec prescribes this but strict purity boundary is violated.
All 20 PROP-SYNC property tests present and structurally sound. However PROP-SYNC-011 has a case-sensitivity precondition issue (FIND-018).
Property tests PROP-SYNC-001 through PROP-SYNC-020 all present with REQ-SYNC mapping annotations.
Integration tests INT-SYNC-001 through INT-SYNC-039 partially present (INT-SYNC-025/026/027/028/036 are structurally weak or tautological).
CLI/resync integration tests INT-SYNC-010 through INT-SYNC-037 present with REQ-SYNC mapping annotations.
PROP-SYNC-011 has case-sensitivity issue in precondition that could cause intermittent false failures.

summary: 18 findings across all 5 dimensions. 4 critical: (1) Missing pg_advisory_xact_lock for concurrent webhook serialization (REQ-SYNC-029), (2) insertPayjpEvent SQL omits ignore_reason/fail_reason/data_metadata_operation_id columns (REQ-SYNC-002/014), (3) validateWebhookToken not constant-time on length mismatch (REQ-SYNC-001), (4) Pure core imports node:crypto native binding. 14 major findings covering: tautological tests (INT-SYNC-025/027/028/036), missing spec behaviors (REQ-SYNC-021 exit code, REQ-SYNC-022 inflight residual, REQ-SYNC-023 failed_count reconciliation, REQ-SYNC-024 escalation log fields), SQL injection surface in dynamic column construction, and test coverage gaps for REQ-SYNC-011 case 2 and Discord retry logic.
